text:
I write sales pages for herbal teas. There's one word I will never write: cure.

It breaks NAFDAC's advertising rules for herbal products, and buyers have heard it too many times. Overclaiming can win one sale. It loses the second.

Coaches, “guaranteed results” is your “cure”. Promise what you control, and let your students' own words carry the results.

#honestmarketing #copywriting #onlinecoach #coursecreator #trust
alts: Slide 1 of 7. Behind the work. I write sales pages for herbal teas. There's one word I will never write.
Slide 2 of 7. The word. Cure. Not in a headline. Not in a caption. Not in a video.

Slide 3 of 7. Reason 1 · The rules. It breaks the rules for herbal products. NAFDAC's advertising rules bar herbal products from being advertised as a cure for the diseases on their list. It also puts your ad account at risk.
Slide 4 of 7. Reason 2 · Trust. Buyers have heard “cure” too many times. The louder the promise, the less they believe it. Overclaiming can win one sale. It loses the second.
Slide 5 of 7. What I write instead. Specific, true, provable. What real buyers report, in their own words. The NAFDAC number, printed where buyers can check it. A clear money back guarantee.
Slide 6 of 7. Coaches, this is yours too. “Guaranteed results” is your “cure”. Promise what you control: the classes, the support, the refund. Let your students' own words carry the results.
Slide 7 of 7. Honesty sells longer. Sell the truth, loudly. Follow for more from inside real sales pages. Photo of Agoro Hassan.

alts: Slide 1 of 10. Page rebuild. What I changed on a sales page, and why.
Slide 2 of 10. The page. Gluvera: a herbal tea sales page on 7o4stores. I wrote it and I built it. Here are 7 changes and the reason behind each. No made up results. Just the decisions.

Slide 3 of 10. Change 1 of 7 1, 15 screenshots became 3 sliders. 15 testimonial screenshots stacked one after another. Nobody scrolls through 15 images on a phone. Three moving sliders keep the proof in view and the page short.

Slide 4 of 10. Change 2 of 7 2, a button that follows you. The sticky order bar waited before it showed up. Now it stays on screen from the first scroll. When someone decides, the button is under their thumb.

Slide 5 of 10. Change 3 of 7 3, a button after every proof. Long stretches of proof with no button after them. People decide right after they see proof. Now there's a button after each of the 3 proof sliders.
Slide 6 of 10. Change 4 of 7 4, buttons that finish the sentence. Every button said the same thing. Now the words match the section: “See My Gluvera Options”, “Choose My Morning Pack”.

Slide 7 of 10. Change 5 of 7 5, a comparison that compares. Rows every seller can claim, like money back and pay on delivery. A comparison only helps where you're different. Those rows went. The rows only this product can claim stayed.
Slide 8 of 10. Change 6 of 7 6, 60 days became 90. A 60 day money back guarantee. Now 90 days. A longer guarantee lowers the buyer's risk, and says you expect the product to deliver.
Slide 9 of 10. Change 7 of 7 7, faith left alone. A line that listed prayer as something that had failed. Removed. Never make a Nigerian buyer choose between your product and their faith.
Slide 10 of 10. Want this on your page? Every change started as a leak. MAP. The Leak Map finds yours. ₦50,000 · 3 working days · 3 leaks or you pay nothing. Photo of Agoro Hassan.
